about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a computer engineer from the University of Alicante, specialized in Software Engineering. I like building software that works in the real world: reliable APIs, well-managed data and AI systems that do something useful beyond a demo.

At Beply I designed the initial multi-agent architecture of their conversational assistant with Google ADK, and at NAX Solutions I built and refactored REST endpoints with Django Ninja for a satellite-data platform and contributed to data migrations from ClickHouse to PostgreSQL. For my bachelor's thesis I built an autonomous navigation system for a simulated drone, guided by a vision-language model, and evaluated it against the approach it started from.
I'm now looking for my first role as a junior backend or applied AI engineer, remote or in Alicante, Valencia, Murcia or elsewhere in Europe.
